inputs.text: America’s second withdrawal from the Paris Agreement under Donald Trump is a reminder that decisions affecting our workers, families, and businesses belong to accountable leaders at home—not distant international processes. Protecting people means more than making promises: it means practical preparedness, strong local institutions, a healthy economy, and the stability families need to endure hard times. Our national self-government is not indifference; it is part of our responsibility to the people who live here.
